title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Copilot for administrators in GCC
summary: Hold: the briefing describes GCC availability of the agent-blocking API as unconfirmed, but Microsoft's Agent 365 service description explicitly lists its agent-registry Graph API governance capabilities as unavailable in GCC. The roadmap facts and the documented portal paths are supported; the licensing gap should be worded more narrowly.
